_comment: Difficulty tier for each painting in the shared `backgrounds` pool (Design Policy §B). Puzzle and Wipe pick a picture for each level from the tier that level maps to, with session no-repeat shared between the two games. Tiers: easy = bold shapes, few regions, high contrast; med = moderate detail; hard = busy, many similar areas. A stem not listed here is eligible at every tier. Hand-edit freely; add new paintings by dropping the art in assets/graphics/pools/backgrounds/ and adding a line here.
